check_box.label: Volumetric Lighting (Godrays)
check_box.tool_tip: Raymarched sun shafts (donor: Black Dragon). Requires shadows (Sun/Moon+Projectors).

check_box.label: Fade unless facing sun
check_box.tool_tip: Directional fade: rays strengthen when the camera faces the sun. NOTE: takes effect after a shader reload (toggle a graphics preset or relog).

slider.name: godray_multiplier_slider
slider.tool_tip: Godray brightness multiplier. 1-5 is a realistic range; higher for stylized shots.

slider.name: godray_resolution_slider
slider.tool_tip: Raymarch sample count. Higher = smoother shafts, more GPU.

slider.name: godray_falloff_slider
slider.tool_tip: Distance falloff. Higher fades shafts out closer to the camera.

text.value: Shafts appear where shadowed air meets sunlit gaps: shoot from inside structures or under canopy, camera across the light, sun low.

check_box.label: Volumetric Projector Cones
check_box.tool_tip: Visible light shafts from shadow-casting projectors (set lights), shaped by the gobo/projection texture. Requires shadows. Independent of the sun godrays above.

slider.name: projvol_multiplier_slider
slider.tool_tip: Projector shaft brightness multiplier. Primary tuning lever.

slider.name: projvol_resolution_slider
slider.tool_tip: Raymarch samples per cone. Bounded local march - fewer needed than the sun godrays. Cost also scales with the number of shadow-casting projectors.

slider.name: projvol_anisotropy_slider
slider.tool_tip: Henyey-Greenstein anisotropy. Higher = stronger forward-scatter glow when looking toward the light; 0 = even scatter from all angles.

text.value: Only shadow-casting projectors cast shafts (raise Max Spot Shadows on the Shadows tab to promote more). Point the camera toward a set light for the strongest glow.

check_box.label: Pin scene textures (no degrade during takes)
check_box.tool_tip: Holds every scene texture at loaded resolution: no downrez, no unload, alt-tab safe. Disables a memory safety valve - use for capture sessions.

slider.name: bd_near_clip_slider
slider.tool_tip: Camera near-clip plane. 0 = stock (0.1m). Lower stops extreme close-ups clipping through geometry; costs scene-wide depth precision.

check_box.label: Render blended faces as masked (fixes alpha z-fighting)
check_box.tool_tip: Routes alpha-blended surfaces through the masked path: writes depth, sorts as solid, stable shadows, works on no-mod content. Legacy materials only (PBR pending).

check_box.label: Include worn / rigged items (hair, clothing)
check_box.tool_tip: Extends forced masking to rigged attachments. Expect visible changes on alpha hair and clothing - a per-shot judgement call.

slider.name: bd_mask_cutoff_slider
slider.tool_tip: How much texture alpha counts as solid. Lower = more texels pass as solid.

check_box.label: Texture pool
check_box.tool_tip: Decoded textures held in system RAM: re-entering view is a memcpy instead of a disk read + re-decode. Off = stock streaming.

check_box.label: Mesh pool
check_box.tool_tip: Unpacked mesh geometry held in system RAM: re-entering draw distance skips disk + parse + face build. Off = stock.

slider.name: bd_texpool_fraction_slider
slider.tool_tip: Fraction of installed RAM the decoded-texture pool may use (0.5 = ~96GB here). Applies within a few seconds.

text.value: Launch-time performance settings (decode threads, cache I/O threads) live in Debug Settings: search 'BDMerge'.

check_box.label: Enable class toggles
check_box.tool_tip: Master gate for the per-class light toggles below.

check_box.label: Limit tracking rotation
check_box.tool_tip: Gate for the degree limits below (stock look-at behavior when off).

slider.name: bd_head_limit_slider
slider.tool_tip: Maximum head-turn toward the look-at target, degrees.

slider.name: bd_eye_limit_slider
slider.tool_tip: Maximum eye rotation toward the look-at target, degrees.

slider.name: bd_rotate_slow_slider
slider.tool_tip: How far the camera can turn before a slow-moving avatar's body follows. Higher = calmer body during pans.

slider.name: bd_rotate_fast_slider
slider.tool_tip: Body-turn threshold while moving fast.

check_box.label: Mouselook: shrink own head (GoPro view, experimental)
check_box.tool_tip: Scales your head bones down in mouselook so hair and lashes stop blocking first-person shots.

combo_box.name: bd_joint_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: BD Bone Camera: the third-person camera focus follows this joint (orbit and zoom stay live). None = stock camera.

check_box.label: Stable projector shadows (set lights keep shadows)
check_box.tool_tip: Award the two projector-shadow slots by light size instead of screen size - camera moves stop stealing your set lights' shadows. Note: SL only ever shadows two projectors at once.

check_box.label: Cinematic head tracking (handheld feel)
check_box.tool_tip: Camera aim and roll subtly follow your avatar's head. Bone camera wins if both are set.

slider.name: bd_max_roll_slider
slider.tool_tip: 1 = camera stays level; lower lets more head roll through.

combo_box.name: ps_preset
combo_box.tool_tip: Apply a complete projector-shaft starting point; Froxel/Voxel Air settings are not changed.

slider.name: ps_BDMergeProjectorVolumetricsTemporalReject_slider
slider.tool_tip: Reduces history where the current and reprojected shaft disagree; higher reacts faster with less ghosting.

check_box.label: Track airborne beam depth
check_box.tool_tip: Reproject temporal history from the shaft's luminance-weighted mean distance instead of the wall behind it.

slider.name: ps_BDMergeProjectorVolumetricsDither_slider
slider.tool_tip: 0 = off; 1 = static; 2 = always animated. Temporal anti-banding can safely cycle mode 1 while history is active.

check_box.label: Temporal anti-banding (no extra samples)
check_box.tool_tip: Cycles the static march phase only while temporal accumulation can average it. Disable for an absolutely frozen sampling pattern.

slider.name: ps_BDMergeFroxelWindAzimuth_slider
slider.tool_tip: Wind compass bearing (0=N, 90=E). Direction the dust comes FROM; by default it drifts the opposite way (0 = blows toward south). Shared by froxel air + beam dust.

slider.name: ps_BDMergeFroxelWindElevation_slider
slider.tool_tip: Wind vertical tilt (-90..90). Positive = comes from above so dust settles downward; negative rises.

check_box.label: Invert wind direction
check_box.name: ps_BDMergeFroxelWindInverted_check
check_box.tool_tip: Invert: off = dust blows opposite the bearing (a north wind blows south); on = blows toward the bearing.

slider.name: ps_BDMergeProjectorVolumetricsMaxDistance_slider
slider.tool_tip: Maximum visible airborne beam length. 0 follows the projector's full light range; surface illumination is unchanged. Hover and scroll the mouse wheel for 0.1 m steps.

check_box.label: Soft projector shadows (contact-hardening + fill)
check_box.tool_tip: Widen the projector-shadow PCF kernel with receiver distance (sharp at contact, softer far away) and lift shadows off pure black toward a fill floor. Off = classic hard shadows.

check_box.label: Also soften sun/moon shadows
check_box.tool_tip: Apply the same contact-hardening + fill to the sun/moon cascade shadows for a consistent look.

check_box.label: Gobo anisotropic/mip filtering (anti-alias)
check_box.tool_tip: Trilinear-mip + anisotropic filtering on projector cookies plus a screen-space LOD clamp, so gobos stay crisp at grazing angles / distance instead of aliasing. Default on.

check_box.label: Enable froxel volumetrics (master)
check_box.tool_tip: Master switch for the hybrid froxel air volumetrics.

check_box.label: Inject projectors into the grid
check_box.tool_tip: Inject volumetric projectors into the froxel grid instead of rendering per-cone shafts.

slider.name: fx_BDMergeFroxelDensity_slider
slider.tool_tip: Base air extinction (sigma_t) per metre before fog and noise.

slider.name: fx_BDMergeFroxelAmbient_slider
slider.tool_tip: Uniform ambient in-scatter 'air glow' of the medium.

slider.name: fx_BDMergeFroxelFogStrength_slider
slider.tool_tip: Height-fog blend (0 = off); denser near ground, thinner up high.

slider.name: fx_BDMergeFroxelFogBase_slider
slider.tool_tip: Ground reference altitude - agent-relative OFFSET from your feet (metres).

slider.name: fx_BDMergeFroxelFogFalloff_slider
slider.tool_tip: Height-fog e-fold falloff distance (metres).

slider.name: fx_BDMergeFroxelFogGroundDensity_slider
slider.tool_tip: Height-fog density at/below the ground reference.

slider.name: fx_BDMergeFroxelNoiseStrength_slider
slider.tool_tip: Animated 3D noise amount - drifting dust motes (tasteful ~0.2-0.35).

slider.name: fx_BDMergeFroxelNoiseScale_slider
slider.tool_tip: Noise spatial scale in cycles per metre (lower = larger clouds).

slider.name: fx_BDMergeFroxelNoiseSpeed_slider
slider.tool_tip: Master noise scroll speed; multiplies the wind vector, negative reverses.

slider.name: fx_BDMergeFroxelWindAzimuth_slider
slider.tool_tip: Wind compass bearing (0=N, 90=E). Direction the dust comes FROM; by default it drifts the opposite way (0 = blows toward south). Shared by froxel air + beam dust.

slider.name: fx_BDMergeFroxelWindElevation_slider
slider.tool_tip: Wind vertical tilt (-90..90). Positive = comes from above so dust settles downward; negative rises.

check_box.label: Invert wind direction
check_box.name: fx_BDMergeFroxelWindInverted_check
check_box.tool_tip: Invert: off = dust blows opposite the bearing (a north wind blows south); on = blows toward the bearing.

slider.name: fx_BDMergeFroxelTemporalBlend_slider
slider.tool_tip: Froxel light-atlas history EMA weight - higher = smoother beams.

text.value: Needs the Proj Shafts master toggle enabled.

slider.name: fx_BDMergeProjectorVolumetricsRimStrength_slider
slider.tool_tip: Directional rim/wrap glow strength on lit silhouettes (sweet spot ~0.75).

slider.name: fx_BDMergeProjectorVolumetricsRimPower_slider
slider.tool_tip: Rim grazing (Fresnel) exponent - higher = thinner edge.

slider.name: fx_BDMergeProjectorVolumetricsRimWrap_slider
slider.tool_tip: How far past the light terminator the rim wraps onto the form.

slider.name: fx_BDMergeProjectorVolumetricsRimSoftness_slider
slider.tool_tip: Softens the rim's grazing falloff for avatar skin.

slider.name: fx_BDMergeProjectorVolumetricsRimThreshold_slider
slider.tool_tip: Incident-light floor - dimly lit surfaces don't glow.

slider.name: fx_BDMergeProjectorVolumetricsBloomFeed_slider
slider.tool_tip: Feed the shaft/rim into the HDR bloom for a soft halo (needs half-res).

slider.name: fx_BDMergeProjectorVolumetricsBloomFeedAnamorphic_slider
slider.tool_tip: Horizontal anamorphic stretch of the bloom-feed halo.

check_box.label: Enable depth haze (master)
check_box.tool_tip: Distant geometry loses contrast toward the atmosphere colour; nearby stays clear. Off = renderer untouched. Sits on top of the sky's own WindLight haze. Mutually exclusive with Froxel Air: while the froxel master is on this layer is automatically disabled.

combo_box.name: ch_preset_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Apply a cinematic depth-haze preset. Height presets (Mist, Valley) anchor the layer at your current camera altitude.

button.label: Reset all
button.name: ch_reset_all
button.tool_tip: Reset every depth-haze setting to its default (haze off).

slider.name: ch_CineHazeStrength_slider
slider.tool_tip: Multiplies the final fog amount. 0 = no work done.

slider.name: ch_CineHazeDensity_slider
slider.tool_tip: Extinction per metre. Transmittance = exp(-density * (distance - start)); 0.004 halves contrast ~173 m past the start distance.

slider.name: ch_CineHazeStartDistance_slider
slider.tool_tip: True camera-to-surface distance (metres) before haze starts accumulating; keeps the subject clear.

slider.name: ch_CineHazeMaxOpacity_slider
slider.tool_tip: Ceiling on how much atmosphere colour can replace the scene, so far geometry stays readable.

combo_box.name: ch_color_mode_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Sky-linked reuses the active WindLight sky's far haze colour per view direction (seamless with the horizon, no screen averaging). Manual uses the swatch below.

color_swatch.name: ch_color_swatch
color_swatch.tool_tip: Atmosphere colour (sRGB picker). White = the brightness of a white sky pixel before exposure.

slider.name: ch_CineHazeColorIntensity_slider
slider.tool_tip: Brightness multiplier on the atmosphere colour (both sources), in linear HDR before exposure.

check_box.label: Height-dependent density (denser low)
check_box.tool_tip: density = base * exp(-falloff * (height - reference)), integrated analytically along each ray. Falloff 0 is exactly uniform haze.

slider.name: ch_CineHazeReferenceHeight_slider
slider.tool_tip: Absolute SL altitude (metres) where the haze has its base density; denser below, thinner above.

button.label: From camera
button.name: ch_ref_from_camera
button.tool_tip: Set the reference height to the current camera altitude.

slider.name: ch_CineHazeHeightFalloff_slider
slider.tool_tip: Density thins by e every 1/falloff metres above the reference (0.05 = 20 m). 0 = uniform.

color_swatch.name: ch_sun_tint_swatch
color_swatch.tool_tip: Warm tint added to the atmosphere colour toward the sun (moon at night, 25%). Applied only through the haze, so zero haze = zero glow; unshadowed (no light shafts).

slider.name: ch_CineHazeSunStrength_slider
slider.tool_tip: Strength of the sun-facing tint. 0 disables the lobe entirely.

slider.name: ch_CineHazeSunLobeWidth_slider
slider.tool_tip: Angle from the sun at which the tint falls to half strength.

combo_box.name: ch_debug_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Replaces the hazed pixels with a diagnostic value (shown through the normal exposure/tonemap). Not saved between sessions.

text.value: Notes: applied in linear HDR before exposure/bloom/tonemap; skipped in reflection probes, HUDs and impostors. Additive particles get transmittance only. Automatically disabled while Froxel Air volumetrics are enabled (that system applies its own distance/height medium).

check_box.label: Enable Rotoscope Ink
check_box.name: ri_enable
check_box.tool_tip: Native ink line pass on depth/normal edges, before AA. Off is a complete no-op.

combo_box.name: ri_preset_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Apply a full ink look (line, colour, sketch, motion) -- writes the values immediately even while Enable above is off (Enable and Subject isolation are never touched by a preset). Turn Enable on to see it.

button.label: Reset all
button.name: ri_reset_all
button.tool_tip: Reset every Rotoscope Ink setting to its default (ink off).

combo_box.name: ri_ink_layer_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Where in the post pipeline the ink line pass runs. Scene: drawn directly into the world before fog, water, haze and glass, so they cover the ink like they would any other surface -- it is exposed physically rather than exposure-compensated (black ink stays black; coloured ink brightens or darkens with the scene like real pigment), and it also shows up in screen-space reflections (glossy floors/water reflect it) and is counted by auto-exposure metering. Camera (default): drawn before Night Mask, Graduated ND/Polarizer and bloom, so those and the glow apply to the ink too, like a captured element. Over atmosphere: drawn after fog and light shafts for a crisp line, still ahead of tonemapping and bloom composite. Overlay: flat, display-referred lines drawn after tonemapping, with no bloom or colour grade -- not available with the S-Log3 capture tonemapper (falls back to Camera).

check_box.label: Silhouette
check_box.name: ri_sil_enable
check_box.tool_tip: Draw the outer silhouette line (a depth discontinuity between the subject and whatever is behind it).

slider.name: ri_sil_thr_slider
slider.tool_tip: How big a relative depth step counts as a silhouette. Only shown/used in Relative depth mode.

slider.name: ri_metric_thr_slider
slider.tool_tip: Depth step in metres that counts as a silhouette. Only shown/used in Metric depth mode.

slider.name: ri_sil_weight_slider
slider.tool_tip: Strength of the silhouette line.

check_box.label: Creases
check_box.name: ri_crease_enable
check_box.tool_tip: Draw inner crease lines: a normal-angle discontinuity on an otherwise continuous surface (panel lines, folds, hard edges).

slider.name: ri_crease_angle_slider
slider.tool_tip: Normal angle in degrees that counts as a crease. Lower catches every fold; higher keeps only hard corners.

slider.name: ri_crease_weight_slider
slider.tool_tip: Strength of the crease lines.

combo_box.name: ri_depth_mode_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Relative compares the depth step to the distance, so the same threshold works both near and far. Metric uses metres, so it needs re-tuning per scene scale.

slider.name: ri_width_slider
slider.tool_tip: Line width in pixels at 1080p, scaled to the current render resolution. Fractional widths are anti-aliased.

slider.name: ri_softness_slider
slider.tool_tip: Threshold feather: 0 is a hard binary line, 1 is a gradual fade on shallow steps and gentle creases.

slider.name: ri_far_cutoff_slider
slider.tool_tip: Lines fade out approaching this view distance in metres. 0 = never fade.

combo_box.name: ri_subject_mode_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Subject = a depth slab around the target, optionally tightened to a screen ellipse around its projected bounds. An object touching the subject at the same depth shares its lines (and the reverse, in 'except' mode).

combo_box.name: ri_subject_targetset_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Mode 3 (Target set) only: which candidates feed the target list. Director subject uses the single Target below; the others gather up to Max targets, nearest first.

spinner.name: ri_subject_max_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Mode 3 only: cap on how many targets are isolated at once (nearest first), 1-16.

combo_box.name: ri_subject_shape_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Mode 3 only: per-target isolation shape drawn around each target's projected bounds.

check_box.label: Colour per target
check_box.name: ri_subject_target_color_check
check_box.tool_tip: Mode 3 only: ink each target with its own palette colour (cycling through 8 colours) instead of the ink colour above.

check_box.label: Invert
check_box.name: ri_subject_invert_check
check_box.tool_tip: Modes 3-9 only: draw the ink everywhere EXCEPT the isolated region instead of only within it.

combo_box.name: ri_subject_target_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Which Director Cast subject to isolate.

slider.name: ri_subject_manual_depth_slider
slider.tool_tip: Subject view depth used when the target is not in world.

slider.name: ri_subject_range_slider
slider.tool_tip: Half depth of the subject slab, in metres, around the subject.

slider.name: ri_subject_feather_slider
slider.tool_tip: Feather distance beyond the slab, in metres.

slider.name: ri_subject_near_slider
slider.tool_tip: Mode 4 (Depth band) only: near edge of the isolated depth band, in metres.

slider.name: ri_subject_far_slider
slider.tool_tip: Mode 4 (Depth band) only: far edge of the isolated depth band, in metres.

slider.name: ri_subject_ellipse_slider
slider.tool_tip: How much a screen ellipse around the subject's projected bounds restricts the slab. 0 = depth only, 1 = fully.

slider.name: ri_subject_ellipse_scale_slider
slider.tool_tip: Ellipse radius as a multiple of the subject's projected half extents.

slider.name: ri_subject_ellipse_feather_slider
slider.tool_tip: Ellipse edge softness, as a fraction of the radius.

slider.name: ri_subject_screen_cx_slider
slider.tool_tip: Modes 7/8 (Screen rectangle/ellipse) only: shape centre X, in screen uv (0 = left edge, 1 = right edge).

slider.name: ri_subject_screen_cy_slider
slider.tool_tip: Modes 7/8 only: shape centre Y, in screen uv (0 = bottom edge, 1 = top edge).

slider.name: ri_subject_screen_rx_slider
slider.tool_tip: Modes 7/8 only: shape half-width, in screen uv.

slider.name: ri_subject_screen_ry_slider
slider.tool_tip: Modes 7/8 only: shape half-height, in screen uv.

combo_box.name: ri_ink_mode_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Fixed uses the swatch below. Match samples the brightest scene colour just outside the edge and keeps only its hue.

color_swatch.name: ri_color_swatch
color_swatch.tool_tip: Ink colour (stored linear). Black for classic ink, white for chalk, saturated for neon.

slider.name: ri_match_reach_slider
slider.tool_tip: Match-light sampling reach outside the edge, in pixels at 1080p. Only used when Ink colour is Match nearby light.

slider.name: ri_intensity_slider
slider.tool_tip: Multiplies the ink colour. Use 1 for classic ink/multiply looks; 4-16 for neon/glow (HDR only; the non-HDR path clips above 1).

slider.name: ri_opacity_slider
slider.tool_tip: Ink opacity.

combo_box.name: ri_blend_mode_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Normal paints the ink over the scene. Multiply only darkens. Add is an HDR glow (the legacy Phase-1 look).

slider.name: ri_glow_slider
slider.tool_tip: Feeds the line into legacy glow / HDR bloom, independent of the blend mode above.

color_swatch.name: ri_color2_swatch
color_swatch.tool_tip: Secondary ink colour (stored linear), used by the colour modes below.

combo_box.name: ri_color2_mode_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Blends in the secondary colour. Two-tone/Rainbow cycle along the edge and/or over time; Highlight tints wherever the motion style spikes; Heat tints wherever the style's own heat field (fire, electric sparks, glitch bands) is hot.

slider.name: ri_color2_speed_slider
slider.tool_tip: Two-tone/Rainbow only: colour cycle speed, cycles per second.

slider.name: ri_color2_length_slider
slider.tool_tip: Two-tone/Rainbow only: cycle length along the edge, in pixels at 1080p (0 = cycle over time only, ignoring position).

check_box.label: Hand-drawn boil
check_box.name: ri_sketch_enable
check_box.tool_tip: The line wobbles and is redrawn a few times per second, like a hand-inked animation frame.

slider.name: ri_sketch_amount_slider
slider.tool_tip: Boil wobble amount, in pixels at 1080p.

slider.name: ri_sketch_detail_slider
slider.tool_tip: 0 gives big lazy undulations, 1 gives tight chatter.

slider.name: ri_sketch_fps_slider
slider.tool_tip: Redraw rate in frames per second (12 = on twos, 8 = on threes). Frame-rate independent.

spinner.name: ri_sketch_strokes_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: How many times the line is drawn (2-4 gives a nervous sketched bundle). Each extra stroke re-evaluates the full line (32 depth/normal taps); 4 strokes at 4K is the heaviest configuration.

slider.name: ri_sketch_roughness_slider
slider.tool_tip: Grain that breaks the line for a dry pencil feel.

slider.name: ri_sketch_seed_slider
slider.tool_tip: Reshuffles the wobble / grain pattern.

combo_box.name: ri_pattern_type_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Overlays a repeating pattern on the line itself, independent of the boil/sketch wobble above.

slider.name: ri_pattern_size_slider
slider.tool_tip: Pattern size in pixels at 1080p: dash period, dot spacing, hatch stripe spacing, or taper noise size.

slider.name: ri_pattern_ratio_slider
slider.tool_tip: Per type: Dashed = dash fill fraction, Dotted = dot size over spacing, Double line = stroke fraction, Hatch = stripe fill, Taper = minimum width fraction.

slider.name: ri_pattern_drift_slider
slider.tool_tip: Dashed/Dotted only: scrolls the pattern along the edge, in pixels per second.

slider.name: ri_hatch_angle_slider
slider.tool_tip: Hatch only: stripe angle in degrees.

slider.name: ri_hatch_reach_slider
slider.tool_tip: Hatch only: 0 hatches the line itself; more adds a hatched shading zone inside the silhouette, at the cost of one extra line evaluation.

check_box.label: Cross-hatch
check_box.name: ri_hatch_cross_check
check_box.tool_tip: Hatch only: also draws the perpendicular stripe set.

slider.name: ri_pattern_seed_slider
slider.tool_tip: Reshuffles the taper noise pattern.

combo_box.name: ri_motion_style_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Animates the line's coverage. None leaves the line static.

slider.name: ri_motion_shape_slider
slider.tool_tip: Per-style secondary parameter -- see the Style tooltip above for what it controls (duty cycle, reveal mode, noise size, and so on). Not used by every style.

text.name: ri_motion_anchor_hint
text.value: This style radiates from the subject target (or the frame centre if none is set), even while Subject isolation above is off.

slider.name: ri_motion_speed_slider
slider.tool_tip: Motion speed, in cycles per second.

slider.name: ri_motion_amount_slider
slider.tool_tip: Motion depth. 0 leaves the line static regardless of style.

slider.name: ri_motion_scale_slider
slider.tool_tip: Per-style scale: Chase tail length, Scan bar width, Wave segment count, Shimmer cell density.

slider.name: ri_motion_angle_slider
slider.tool_tip: Sweep/reveal/diagonal direction in degrees, for the styles that use an angle (Scan, Barber Pole, Laser Scan, Paint-On, Write-On).

combo_box.name: ri_motion2_style_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: A second animation multiplied onto the first. Copy-type styles (Echo Aura, Smoke Wisps, Ink Drip, Splatter, Lightning Arcs) only ever run from ONE layer -- the first one wins if both layers pick a copy style.

slider.name: ri_motion2_speed_slider
slider.tool_tip: Second motion layer speed, in cycles per second (or cycles per beat under Tempo).

slider.name: ri_motion2_amount_slider
slider.tool_tip: Second motion layer depth. 0 leaves it static regardless of style.

slider.name: ri_motion2_scale_slider
slider.tool_tip: Second motion layer per-style scale (same meaning as the first layer's Scale, for the style chosen above).

slider.name: ri_motion2_shape_slider
slider.tool_tip: Second motion layer per-style secondary parameter (same meaning as the first layer's Shape).

slider.name: ri_motion2_angle_slider
slider.tool_tip: Second motion layer sweep/reveal/diagonal direction, for the styles that use an angle (Scan, Laser Scan, Barber Pole, Paint-On, Write-On).

text.name: ri_motion2_anchor_hint
text.value: This style radiates from the subject target (or the frame centre if none is set), even while Subject isolation above is off.

slider.name: ri_motion_tempo_slider
slider.tool_tip: 0 = motion speeds are plain cycles per second. Above 0, every motion speed becomes cycles PER BEAT and locks to this tempo -- handy for syncing to music.

slider.name: ri_motion_phase_slider
slider.tool_tip: Only used when Tempo is above 0: offsets the beat clock, in beats, so multiple ink layers or props can be put on or off the beat relative to each other.

combo_box.name: ri_motion_step_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Holds the motion clock to a stepped frame rate for a hand-animated feel, independent of the boil/sketch redraw rate above.

slider.name: ri_motion_seed_slider
slider.tool_tip: Reshuffles the hashed-frame motion styles (Strobe, Electric, Neon Buzz, Morse Blink, Film Jitter, Splatter, Lightning Arcs).

text.value: Notes: subject isolation is a depth slab, not a true per-actor mask -- another object at the same depth inside the ellipse (a chair the actor sits on) shares its lines, and Everything-except-subject leaks the same way in reverse. HDR intensity above 1 only matters with HDR rendering; the non-HDR path clips it.

text.name: sl_status
text.value: Select a spotlight projector in-world to edit it here.

check_box.name: sl_cast_shadows
check_box.label: Cast shadows
check_box.tool_tip: Uncheck to make this projector light-only (no shadow), freeing its shadow slot for other projectors. Session-only.

check_box.name: sl_volumetric
check_box.label: Volumetric shaft (light cone)
check_box.tool_tip: Opt this projector in to the volumetric light-cone effect. Requires the master toggle on the Proj Shafts tab. Session-only.

color_swatch.name: sl_gobo_tint
color_swatch.tool_tip: Colored gel multiplied onto the cookie. White = no tint.

slider.name: sl_gobo_var1
slider.tool_tip: Pattern detail / count. 0 = default look.

slider.name: sl_gobo_var2
slider.tool_tip: Secondary variation (thickness / tilt / blend). 0 = default.

slider.name: sl_gobo_soft
slider.tool_tip: Edge softness. 0 = default.
